claims: Human landing on the Moon with the Artemis program is currently scheduled for the Artemis III mission.
The Artemis III mission is aimed for 2027.
The Artemis III mission will mark the first crewed lunar landing since 1972.
The Artemis III mission focuses on the lunar South Pole.
Another crewed landing following Artemis III is planned for 2028 under the Artemis IV mission.
Artemis II completed a crewed flyby of the Moon.
Artemis II had a splashdown on April 10, 2026.
Artemis III is planned to be the first crewed landing on the lunar surface.
Artemis III will utilize SpaceX's Starship or Blue Origin's lander.
Artemis IV is scheduled as the second crewed landing mission to continue building a sustainable presence.
